summary: Full E2E test of Admin → Starter Kit → Purchases redesigned page. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass covering response shape, methods list, all sort variants (newest/oldest/amount_high/amount_low/partner/partner_desc), q/status/method/date filters, and tracking status update round-trip (restored to 'processing'). Frontend: header switch, 4 analytics cards, search + clear, empty state, method dropdown w/ 'mock' option + active-filter tag, custom calendar (panel opens, cal-next disabled on current month, cal-title 'September 2026', Today picks single-day range, Apply→tag-date, Escape closes, date-clear), quick presets (7 activates and re-click clears), all 5 status chips w/ counts, sk-clear resets, table + sort headers, sk-showing 'Showing 1–1 of 1 purchase', drawer open + timeline + name/amount, drawer track change to 'shipped' updates chip and toast fires, Escape closes drawer, inline sk-track-<id> restores to processing, mobile 390px switches to sk-cards with no horizontal overflow. State restored to 'processing' at end as required.

issues: React DOM hydration warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Not triggered by StarterKitPurchases (all its <option> children are plain text) — traced to a sibling component in PanelLayout / nav badges select. Cosmetic warning only, no functional impact.

action_items: Optional: Track down the <span> inside <option> hydration warning in a shared admin layout Select (not blocking; source is outside StarterKitPurchases feature files).
critical_code_review_comments: StarterKitPurchases.jsx is ~340 lines and reads clean — Dropdown, SortHead, FilterTag well-factored.
Backend admin_purchases: uses ISO string range for created_at which correctly excludes future partial-day; ObjectId excluded via projection. Good.
SORT_API map in frontend correctly translates UI sort key to API sort param; all 6 variants exercised via pytest.
Empty state uses different subtitle when total_all==0 vs filtered==0 — good UX.
